title: prefix[i] is the sum of the first i elements, so any subarray sum is one subtraction
caption: prefix has one more slot than nums. The leading 0 is the sum of nothing, so ranges that start at 0 need no special case.

frames.text: Setup is one O(n) pass: prefix[0] = 0 and prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + nums[i].
sum(nums[1..3]) = prefix[4] − prefix[1] = 1 − 3 = −2, which matches 4 − 7 + 1. Two reads, O(1) per query.
A range that starts at 0 uses the leading 0: sum(nums[0..4]) = prefix[5] − prefix[0] = 4 − 0 = 4.
